statement.p: Find the area of the region between y=x^{1/2} and y=x^{1/5} for 0 \leq x \leq 1.

static.solution:
y=x^{1/2} is below the curve y=x^{1/5} for 0\le x\le 1, as shown in the figure below (the bottom curve, in blue, is y = x^{1/2}, and the top, in black, is y = x^{1/5}).
(Click on the graph for a larger version.)
Therefore, \mbox{Area } = \int_{0}^{1} (x^{1/5} - x^{1/2}) dx = 0.167. The integral was evaluated on a calculator.
